entries.what: Indigenous Peoples' Day, no classes at Bayshore State. Arjun sleeps in, then tweaks resume v19 and updates the spreadsheet at the kitchen table in unit 132.
entries.outcome: Fixed two bullets and logged three new applications.

entries.what: Afternoon at Ruiz Family Market for groceries, then quiet dinner with Marcus before Marcus leaves for his Ridgeline night shift.
entries.outcome: Stocked up on lentils and eggs; kept the apartment quiet for Marcus's nap.

entries.what: Takes the 6:48 Tule Line north from Flats Junction after grabbing masala chai at Anh's cart, then sits through the Tuesday operations management lecture with Dr. Ashby.
entries.outcome: On time; took notes for the midterm on Oct 23.

entries.what: At 3 p.m. Arjun does a mock interview with Lena at the career center, answering 'tell me about yourself' standing up, and agrees to make it a standing Tuesday slot.
entries.outcome: Committed to weekly Tuesday 3 p.m. mocks after two earlier reschedules.

entries.what: Evening on the train home and a late night on LinkedIn messages to alumni, one per weekday as planned.
entries.outcome: Sent one alum message; in bed around 1:30.

entries.what: MWF classes 9 to 12 at Bayshore, then ten hours-a-week shift at the career center front desk.
entries.outcome: Checked in students and handed out interview-prep flyers.

entries.what: Back at the apartment Arjun cooks rajma and rice, then updates the spreadsheet and does supply chain club planning by text.
entries.outcome: Marcus wakes up and eats leftovers; spreadsheet current.

entries.what: Thursday operations management class, then Dr. Ashby's office hours at 2 where Arjun knocks despite the closed door and talks about his goals.
entries.outcome: Ashby agrees to write the recommendation letter.

entries.what: Thursday night laundry at the card-only machines at Marisol Gardens while sending a thank-you email to Ashby.
entries.outcome: Clean clothes and a sent thank-you.

entries.what: Friday classes and a short career center shift; hears at the desk that Greg's old IT job at Ridgeline is going to someone new, a thing Marcus mentioned.
entries.outcome: Nothing needed from him; just noted it.

entries.what: Evening he picks up chai on Anh's tab, then spends an hour on cover letters for two logistics analyst internships.
Saturday morning run on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop, about four miles.
Afternoon at Heron & Grind with his laptop and its sticky e key, prepping case team slides and the Sunita wedding vendor sheet.
entries.outcome: Slides outlined; vendor sheet gained six rows.

entries.what: Sunday: rajma meal prep in the morning, then dinner at his parents' Pell Road house with Manpreet, who asks about internships and sends him home with dal.
entries.outcome: Told her about Ashby's letter; she sounded relieved.

entries.what: Late at night Arjun finishes case team slides near 2 a.m. and drafts a message telling a teammate to stop pulling all-nighters.
entries.outcome: Sent the message, then stayed up another twenty minutes.
